metadata.description: 24 engineer-role plugins for SRE, DevOps, platform, AI infrastructure, security and more, plus the vendored Anthropic knowledge-work plugins.

plugins.name: mlops-engineer
plugins.description: MLOps Engineer: Reproducible training pipelines, model registry, deployment gates and drift monitoring.

plugins.name: llmops-engineer
plugins.description: LLMOps Engineer: Prompt versioning, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, gateways and LLM cost control.

plugins.name: ai-infra-engineer
plugins.description: AI Infrastructure Engineer: GPU scheduling, inference serving, batching, quantisation and capacity planning.

plugins.name: rag-engineer
plugins.description: RAG Engineer: Chunking, hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding and retrieval quality measurement.

plugins.name: agent-engineer
plugins.description: Agent Engineer: Tool-using agents, MCP servers, orchestration graphs, memory and safe autonomy.

plugins.name: data-engineer
plugins.description: Data Engineer: Pipelines, data contracts, quality checks, lakehouse modelling and streaming reliability.

plugins.name: sre-engineer
plugins.description: Site Reliability Engineer: SLOs, error budgets, burn-rate alerting and toil elimination for production services.

plugins.name: devops-engineer
plugins.description: DevOps Engineer: CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, rollback safety and delivery metrics.

plugins.name: platform-engineer
plugins.description: Platform Engineer: Internal developer platforms, golden paths, service catalogs and developer-experience metrics.

plugins.name: cloud-engineer
plugins.description: Cloud Engineer: Landing zones, Well-Architected reviews, migration planning and multi-account governance.

plugins.name: kubernetes-engineer
plugins.description: Kubernetes Engineer: Workload hardening, resource tuning and systematic cluster troubleshooting.

plugins.name: iac-engineer
plugins.description: Infrastructure as Code Engineer: Terraform and OpenTofu module design, safe plan review, state hygiene and drift control.

plugins.name: observability-engineer
plugins.description: Observability Engineer: Metrics, logs and traces with OpenTelemetry, cardinality control and actionable alerting.

plugins.name: network-engineer
plugins.description: Network Engineer: Cloud and hybrid network design, DNS, segmentation and connectivity troubleshooting.

plugins.name: database-engineer
plugins.description: Database Reliability Engineer: Schema migrations, query tuning, replication, backups and restore verification.

plugins.name: finops-engineer
plugins.description: FinOps Engineer: Cloud cost allocation, rightsizing, commitment strategy and unit economics.

plugins.name: incident-commander
plugins.description: Incident Commander: Severity classification, command structure, status communication and blameless postmortems.

plugins.name: release-engineer
plugins.description: Release Engineer: Versioning, changelogs, release trains, hotfix flow and supply-chain-safe publishing.

plugins.name: forward-deployed-engineer
plugins.description: Forward Deployed AI Engineer: Bridging client discovery, agentic AI architecture, air-gapped private VPC deployments, and continuous acceptance evals.

plugins.name: devsecops-engineer
plugins.description: DevSecOps Engineer: Shift-left scanning, SBOMs, signed artifacts, SLSA provenance and runtime enforcement.

plugins.name: appsec-engineer
plugins.description: Application Security Engineer: Threat modelling, secure code review, OWASP controls and LLM application security.

plugins.name: compliance-engineer
plugins.description: Compliance Engineer: Control mapping, continuous evidence collection, audit readiness and policy as code.

plugins.name: qa-engineer
plugins.description: QA and Test Automation Engineer: Test strategy, automation pyramid, flaky test control and contract testing.

plugins.name: performance-engineer
plugins.description: Performance Engineer: Load testing, profiling, capacity modelling and tail-latency analysis.

plugins.name: backend-engineer
plugins.description: Backend Engineer: API design, resilience patterns, idempotency, caching and service boundaries.

plugins.name: bio-research
plugins.description: Connect to preclinical research tools and databases (literature search, genomics analysis, target prioritization) to accelerate early-stage life sciences R&D

plugins.name: cowork-plugin-management
plugins.description: Create, customize, and manage plugins tailored to your organization's tools and workflows. Configure MCP servers, adjust plugin behavior, and adapt templates to match how your team works.

plugins.name: customer-support
plugins.description: Triage tickets, draft responses, escalate issues, and build your knowledge base. Research customer context and turn resolved issues into self-service content.

plugins.name: data
plugins.description: Write SQL, explore datasets, and generate insights faster. Build visualizations and dashboards, and turn raw data into clear stories for stakeholders.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Accelerate design workflows — critique, design system management, UX writing, accessibility audits, research synthesis, and dev handoff. From exploration to pixel-perfect specs.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Streamline engineering workflows — standups, code review, architecture decisions, incident response, and technical documentation. Works with your existing tools or standalone.

plugins.name: enterprise-search
plugins.description: Search across all of your company's tools in one place. Find anything across email, chat, documents, and wikis without switching between apps.

plugins.name: finance
plugins.description: Streamline finance and accounting workflows, from journal entries and reconciliation to financial statements and variance analysis. Speed up audit prep, month-end close, and keeping your books clean.

plugins.name: human-resources
plugins.description: Streamline people operations — recruiting, onboarding, performance reviews, compensation analysis, and policy guidance. Maintain compliance and keep your team running smoothly.

plugins.name: legal
plugins.description: Speed up contract review, NDA triage, and compliance workflows for in-house legal teams. Draft legal briefs, organize precedent research, and manage institutional knowledge.

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: Create content, plan campaigns, and analyze performance across marketing channels. Maintain brand voice consistency, track competitors, and report on what's working.

plugins.name: operations
plugins.description: Optimize business operations — vendor management, process documentation, change management, capacity planning, and compliance tracking. Keep your organization running efficiently.

plugins.name: pdf-viewer
plugins.description: View, annotate, and sign PDFs in a live interactive viewer. Mark up contracts, fill forms with visual feedback, stamp approvals, and place signatures — then download the annotated copy.

plugins.name: product-management
plugins.description: Write feature specs, plan roadmaps, and synthesize user research faster. Keep stakeholders updated and stay ahead of the competitive landscape.

plugins.name: productivity
plugins.description: Manage tasks, plan your day, and build up memory of important context about your work. Syncs with your calendar, email, and chat to keep everything organized and on track.

plugins.name: sales
plugins.description: Sales skills that work with the tools your team already uses - your CRM, email, calendar, chat and call recorder - or with uploaded files. Prep calls, summarize and follow up, research accounts, review deals and pipeline, and write the forecast. When you ask, it can update CRM records, create…

plugins.name: small-business
plugins.description: Pre-built small business workflows to help you run and grow your business. Supports a majority of the tools you already use. You approve every step that touches money or customers. Install and then ask Claude to help you get onboarded.
